name: 29 — migration_check PASSES → migration commits (PR-6d, node-log validated)
description:
Single-node lazy migration whose `#[app::migration_check]` ACCEPTS the produced v2 root, so the migration COMMITS (PR-6d task 6d.6).
The v2 fixture (`scenario-migration-check-pass-v2`) exports a `__calimero_migration_check` predicate built from the SDK helper `entity_count_parity`. Its migrate carries every v1 item through 1:1, so the pre-commit check sees equal item counts and returns `true`. The runtime then proceeds past the check into `write_migration_state` + finalize: the context reaches v2 with the v1 items preserved and a new `notes` field seeded.
Node-log validation (the explicit requirement for scenario 29):
  - `assert_log_present "migration_check passed"` — the pre-commit check ran
    on the produced v2 root and accepted it (PR-6d task 6d.3 emit).
  - `assert_log_absent "migration_check failed: logical abort"` — the commit
    path was taken, NOT the abort path. A passing check must never log a
    logical abort.

Because migration_v2 defaults ON (PR-6b task 6b.8), the pre-commit check runs natively — no merobox feature flag is needed.
